nodes.label: Moebius: 0.2B Lightweight Image Inpainting Framework
nodes.rationale: Proposes extreme compression of diffusion-based inpainting via LλMI blocks and adaptive multi-granularity distillation, achieving 0.22B parameters with 10B-level quality and >15× speedup vs FLUX.1-Fill-Dev.

nodes.label: Local-λ Mix Interaction (LλMI) Block
nodes.rationale: Combines Local-λ (self-attention via spatial/semantic context matrices), Interactive-λ (cross-attention with LCG embeddings), and Mix-FFN to achieve extreme parameter efficiency while preserving semantic reasoning for inpainting.

nodes.label: Latent Diffusion Model (LDM) Framework
nodes.rationale: Foundational architecture for Moebius: encodes images to latent space via VAE, applies denoising U-Net with LCG semantic guidance, enables efficient training and inference in compressed latent domain.

nodes.label: Latent Categories Guidance (LCG)
nodes.rationale: Semantic embedding paradigm extracting latent category distributions from unmasked regions; injected via cross-attention to provide global semantic priors for coherent inpainting.

nodes.label: Representation Bottleneck in Compact Networks
nodes.rationale: Empirical finding that naive substitution of standard operators (attention, FFN) with lightweight variants (GLA, DWConv) causes catastrophic quality degradation (FID 32.75→43.58); solved by architectural synergy of LλMI + distillation.

nodes.label: Adaptive Gradient-Based Loss Balancing
nodes.rationale: Dynamically adjusts weights of coarse-grained, fine-grained, and perceptual distillation losses based on gradient norms, stabilizing joint optimization and eliminating manual hyperparameter tuning.

nodes.label: Places2 Inpainting Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Natural scene inpainting evaluation: 10K test subset at 512×512 with 40–50% masks; Moebius achieves 0.92 FID and 0.091 LPIPS, matching or exceeding 10B-level industrial models.

nodes.label: CelebA-HQ Portrait Inpainting Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Portrait domain evaluation: 3K images at 512×512 with large masks; Moebius achieves 5.39 FID and 0.122 LPIPS, surpassing all diffusion baselines except teacher PixelHacker.

nodes.label: FFHQ Portrait Inpainting Benchmark
nodes.rationale: High-resolution portrait evaluation: 10K images at 256×256 with LaMa-style masks; Moebius achieves 8.15 FID and 0.231 LPIPS, eclipsing 10B-level industrial models by 37–1243% in FID.

nodes.label: FLUX.1-Fill-Dev: 10B Industrial Baseline
nodes.rationale: Industrial generalist foundation model (11.9B parameters) serving as primary efficiency and quality comparison; Moebius achieves comparable quality with <2% parameters and >15× speedup.

nodes.label: SD3.5 Large-Inpainting: 8B Industrial Baseline
nodes.rationale: Industrial generalist inpainting model (8.05B parameters); Moebius surpasses it on portrait benchmarks (37–1243% FID improvement) while using 3% of parameters.

nodes.label: Depthwise Convolution (DWConv)
nodes.rationale: Lightweight operator decoupling spatial and channel interactions; Moebius uses Depthwise Residual Blocks (DW.Res) to replace standard convolutions, reducing parameters from 526M to 315M.

nodes.label: Mix-FFN: Efficient Feed-Forward Network
nodes.rationale: Replaces dense linear projections with depthwise-augmented structure; Moebius integrates Mix-FFN to slash additional 48M parameters while preserving LPIPS quality (0.262→0.258).

nodes.label: Gated Linear Attention (GLA)
nodes.rationale: Efficient self-attention mechanism; Moebius identifies GLA lacks cross-attention formulation, motivating Interactive-λ module to handle LCG semantic priors.

nodes.label: E-LatentLPIPS: Latent Perceptual Loss
nodes.rationale: Memory-efficient perceptual constraint in latent space; Moebius uses E-LatentLPIPS to enhance generation quality without expensive pixel-space decoding during training.

nodes.label: VAE Encoder: SDXL Variant
nodes.rationale: Pre-trained variational autoencoder for latent space encoding; Moebius shares SDXL VAE with teacher PixelHacker to ensure consistent latent representations.

nodes.label: Double-Blind User Study: Perceptual Quality
nodes.rationale: 50 cases per scenario, 22 participants (experts + general users), forced-choice preference tests; Moebius achieves 31.76% average preference, matching teacher (32.18%) and surpassing FLUX.1-Fill-Dev (23.70%).

nodes.label: Extreme Compression Paradigm: Task-Specific Specialist
nodes.rationale: Core thesis: highly optimized task-specific specialist (0.22B) can bridge massive scale gap and match 10B-level generalist performance by pushing architectural efficiency to limits via LλMI + distillation synergy.

nodes.label: Moebius: Lightweight Image Inpainting Model
nodes.rationale: 0.22B parameter specialist model for image inpainting, designed through extreme structural compression and knowledge distillation from PixelHacker teacher model

nodes.label: PixelHacker: Teacher Model for Moebius
nodes.rationale: 1B-parameter teacher model that provides structural and semantic consistency for Moebius distillation; Moebius inherits its precise texture synthesis capabilities

nodes.label: LλMI Blocks: Lightweight Architecture Component
nodes.rationale: Proposed architectural innovation in Moebius that bridges capacity gap between 0.22B model and 1B teacher through adaptive distillation

nodes.label: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) Scale Ablation
nodes.source_location: Ablation Study on Classifier-Free Guidance Scale
nodes.rationale: Empirical validation showing optimal CFG scales of 2.5 (natural scenes) and 2.0 (portrait scenes) for balancing sample quality and diversity

nodes.label: Places2 Dataset: Natural Scene Evaluation
nodes.rationale: 10 million image database used for evaluating Moebius on natural scene inpainting tasks

nodes.label: CelebA-HQ Dataset: Portrait Evaluation
nodes.rationale: High-resolution face dataset used for evaluating Moebius on portrait inpainting and facial feature restoration

nodes.label: FFHQ Dataset: Facial Image Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Flickr-Faces-HQ dataset used alongside CelebA-HQ for comprehensive portrait scene evaluation

nodes.label: FLUX.1-Fill-Dev: Commercial Baseline Model
nodes.rationale: 10B-level industrial generalist model used as comparison baseline; demonstrates Moebius achieves competitive quality with 45x fewer parameters

nodes.label: SD3.5 Large-Inp: Stable Diffusion Baseline
nodes.rationale: 10B-level generalist model baseline for inpainting comparison; Moebius demonstrates superior contextual consistency despite massive scale gap

nodes.label: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Evaluation Protocol
nodes.rationale: Validation of Moebius generalization using LVIS (10k natural images) and DeepFakeFace (3k portrait images) as OOD datasets

edges.source_location: Ablation Study on Classifier-Free Guidance Scale
